bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.export_aud: When enabled,automatically generates an SRT subtitle file containing audio filenames when exporting videos
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_mode.t: Click to switch the tween effect from this texture keyframe to the next one.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_revers: When enabled, this dissipate segment restores from transparent to the next keyframe texture.
When enabled, dissipating pixels show the flash color before becoming transparent. Lower color opacity mixes in more of the original pixel.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_flash_: Sets the dissipate flash color; lower opacity mixes in more of the original pixel.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_pbr_gl: Makes flashing pixels emissive through the LabPBR specular alpha channel. Requires a shader pack with LabPBR emission support.
Enter 0–100 or drag left and right to set the LabPBR emission strength during the white flash.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_block_: Changes neighboring texture pixels as one block. 3x3 or 5x5 reduces fine-grained noise on high-resolution textures.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_dissip: Controls the sharpness of dissipate spread. Higher values reduce random noise, making the origin clearer and the gradient edge narrower; lower values produce a softer, more natural spread.
bbsppp.ui.keyframes.texture_tween_origin: Right-click the model surface to choose the origin; left-drag to rotate, middle-drag to pan, and use Ctrl + scroll to zoom. Fine-tune with X/Y/Z.
This model does not support spread origin
The current model lacks parseable 3D geometry (e.g. emoticons, bobj, or other sprite/special-format models), so the spread origin cannot be picked on the model surface.
